text:
maria: Morning team 44b First day but I'm stuck - Okta accepted my password but MFA tries to send an SMS to a number I no longer have. It offers 'Use backup code' but I never received any. Also 1Password invite hasn't arrived and I see 'request access' on the marketing drive folder. Who's the right person to get me unblocked quickly?

ben-it: Welcome @maria! We can do a couple quick things: 1) issue temporary backup codes and 2) enable TOTP so you can add it to 1Password. Which phone number did you use on the application?

maria: The recruiter had my old uk number +44 7700 900000. My new number is +1 415 555 0199. I tried the "need help" link in the Okta flow but it loops back.

onboard-bot: Ticket created: ONB-5991 88 "Maria: SMS to old number, backup codes + 1Password missing". Assigned to ben-it. ETA 60 minutes.

ben-it: I created 10 one-time backup codes and posted them to your work email (maria@redwood.ai). I'm also toggling SMS->disabled and enabling TOTP for 24h to let you enroll via 1Password. Resent 1Password invite.

maria: Got the backup codes in email and the 1Password invite appeared. Set up 1Password and added the TOTP entry. MFA accepted the TOTP and I can log in now. Still can't open the marketing drive folder though - it's showing 'request access'.

nick-security: @ben-it FYI I saw a recent policy that blocks Drive access until device trust + corporate VPN are connected for marketing assets. Maria, are you on the corp VPN?

maria: I'm on home wifi, not on VPN. I didn't think VPN was required for docs.

ben-it: For marketing folders we require the VPN for now (sensitive campaign data). I just added you to a temporary allowlist for 2 hours so you can grab onboarding docs. Please connect to corp-vpn.redwood.ai and re-run Okta device enroll when you have time.

maria: Connected to VPN and re-ran enroll. Device Trust prompt asked for the profile install and now shows Enrolled in Okta. Drive access works and I can see the marketing folder. All good! Thanks for the quick turnaround :thumbsup:

ben-it: Great, I'll close ONB-5991 after a quick audit. If you want, we can update your phone number in Okta now so SMS won't be sent to your old UK number.

maria: Please update to +1 415 555 0199. Also happy to enable a passkey later - how do I create one on mac?

nick-security: On mac: System Settings -> Passwords -> Passkeys -> Create new passkey (Safari) or Chrome settings -> Passwords -> Passkeys. We'll migrate you to passkey-only MFA next week. "Welcome aboard!"
